verdict.rationale: Poly documents two first-party headless paths. The first is a hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app/mcp, which a runtime probe confirmed is live and speaking OAuth; it exposes search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI as tools. The second is a local `poly` CLI whose agent skill explicitly lets agents search, read, create, update and organize files, including Markdown journal notes in the Mind folder. The Claude Code plugin also documents full access to Poly files. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that writes work through MCP/CLI (the probe only confirmed the auth handshake), and a fully non-interactive auth path (first MCP connection requires browser OAuth); no public REST/OpenAPI vendor API was found.
